src/companion/.description: Companion module for mobile app WebSocket connectivity. Contains types for CompanionRequest/Response/Event messages, CompanionServer for WebSocket handling, and handlers for workout control and metrics. Default port 9876 with optional PIN authentication.

src/companion/types.rs.description: Contains all WebSocket API types: CompanionRequest (12 variants), CompanionResponse (11 variants), CompanionEvent (4 variants). Uses serde tag-based serialization. Supporting types: CompanionErrorCode, SessionState, SessionStatusInfo, RideSummary, RideDetailInfo, CompanionClient.
